summary: A standard single-line text input field, like you'd use for a name or search box.
description: A single-line text input custom element with an associated label, optional description/icon/support link, and form-association support. Extends the shared MozBaseInputElement base class (toolkit/content/widgets/lit-utils.mjs), which supplies most of its attrs, slots, and layout.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input control.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the input control.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the input control.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: The readonly state of the input control.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The required state of the input control. Declared directly in moz-input-text.mjs's own static properties, not inherited from MozBaseInputElement.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the input control.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page).

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text to display when the input has no value.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Plain HTML attribute (not a declared Lit reactive property) toggled by the consumer to show an error state, styled via the :host([invalid]) CSS selector (red border/accent-color). Used in moz-input-text.stories.mjs; not documented in the class JSDoc.

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: Internal: set by a parent input/fieldset to cascade a disabled state.

attributes.name: inputLayout
attributes.description: Internal layout mode ("inline" | "block" | "inline-end"); moz-input-text overrides the base default to "block".

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner input.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Rendered when the description property is unset, letting callers supply richer description markup.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Rendered when supportPage is unset, letting callers supply a custom support link element.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event as the user types; handled internally to update value and (being composed) naturally crosses the shadow boundary.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched from the native input's change event (native change does not cross shadow boundaries by default, so MozBaseInputElement.redispatchEvent re-fires it on the host).

usage: <moz-input-text name="example" label="Display name" placeholder="Enter a name"></moz-input-text>
